sources.citation: Honda EU7000is Owner's Manual 00X31Z376200 (2020), https://cdn.powerequipment.honda.com/pe/pdf/manuals/00X31Z376200.pdf pp54–56, 102 (wiring), 117–119; Honda Generator Accessories catalogue https://cdn.powerequipment.honda.com/pe/pdf/Accessories/generators.pdf p5-15; Magnum ME-AGS-N note https://www.magnum-dimensions.com/sites/default/files/MagDocs/ME-AGS-N%20(Honda%20EU7000is%20with%20remote%20plug)%20Rev%202-13-2018DM.PDF (checked: 2026-09-01)

transport: maintained RUN contact + momentary START contact (closest catalogue class: "3-wire momentary START + STOP contacts") — wiring diagram p102 shows the remote box as MAIN SW across `MAIN_SW+` (Br/Bu) / `MAIN_SW−` (W/Bu), START SW across `PUSH_SW2` (W/G) / GND (G), and a pilot-lamp output `PL(REM)` (G/Bu); Magnum: "ON = Maintain close, START = Momentary close" · open-circuit voltage: ? · contact current: ? (Magnum shows a ≤5 A fuse on its relay side only) · generator MAIN switch must be ON (p54; Magnum: "Turn and leave generator key in ON Position") · factory shorting plug must be removed for a remote and refitted without one — "the generator will not start without it" (PII54855 p2).

models.name: EU7000is EEJD-1000001–1299999
models.notes: Wired kits 32380-Z37-800ZA (33 ft) / -820ZA (98 ft); "not applicable to CO-Minder (AG) models" (cat. p5-15)

models.name: EU7000is EEJD-1300001+ (CO-Minder)
models.notes: "built-in wireless start/stop" (cat. p5-15); remote-kit page still present in 2020 OM

gotchas: "The ENGINE START button functions for 5 seconds. As soon as the engine starts, the starter will stop automatically ... wait at least 10 seconds before operating the starter again" (p54). Cranking is internally timed; a controller on this input only pulses START.
Remote MAIN OFF vetoes the panel: "pressing the ENGINE START button on the control panel will crank the engine, but the engine will not start" (p56).

After a CO-Minder shutdown the engine "cannot be started remotely ... unless the engine is started using the ENGINE START button on the control panel once" (p56) — a remote site cannot recover from this.
Connector naming drifts: 2019 OM says "plug", 2020 OM "6-pin coupler" + "4-pin coupler" (p117), Honda's PII54855 says "8-pin remote connector". Verify on the unit.
Magnum's suggested timing on this input: start 5 s, 2 min between attempts, 4 attempts.
